summary: Class 7 ICSE Biology Topic 04: Human Digestive System & Nutrition in the warm editorial aesthetic (#fbfaf7 ivory canvas, Newsreader serif, rich black #161514). Features the 5 stages of holozoic nutrition (Ingestion, Digestion, Absorption, Assimilation, Egestion), chemical enzyme digestion table (Salivary Amylase, Pepsin, Trypsin, Lipase, Bile), and small intestine villi structure. Zero SVGs.
